2.The auto-renewing subscription will be automatically charged and renewed within 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period, and you can cancel the auto-renewing subscription 24 hours in advance in Play Store.
3.If you cancel the subscription, the payment that has already occurred will not be refunded, but you can still enjoy the benefits until the end of the current period, and no charges will occur after that.
4.Subscription purchased from within this app will be charged to your Play Store account and are subject to Play Store's Refund Policy.
5.You must switch to the Google account when you purchased the subscription in Play Store in order to maintain your subscriber status within this app.

"Your subscription may have issues for various reasons:
1.There may be a problem with your device's network connection, the subscription status can not be fetched from online. In this case, you should fix the network connection and retry.
2.You may have switched the account or region (for example, through a VPN) in Play Store. In this case, you should switch back to the account and region when you purchased the subscription, and you may even need to clear the data in Play Store.
3.You may have switched to a new device. In this case, you should logged with the Google account when purchased the subscription in Play Store of the new device.
4.Your subscription may have expired. In this case, you can click \"Manage it in Play\", and then you will be redirected to the subscription management page in Play Store, or you can also purchase the subscription here."

Backup completion typically takes several minutes to a dozen minutes, depending on various factors. Please ensure that our app is running in the foreground during the backup process to avoid interruptions or failures.

To route network traffic for the VM, a VPN connection needs to be established on your device. This connection will be used solely for the VM and will not affect any other network connectivity on your device.

Another VPN is currently set to \"Always-on.\" Due to system restrictions, we cannot replace this connection. Please go to the Settings, tap the gear icon next to the active VPN, and disable \"Always-on VPN\" before trying again.

Canceling backup will immediately stop the backup and delete any files related to it. Background running will continue the backup in the background, and you can still check the backup progress at any time.

Welcome to Virtual Master. Please read the Privacy Statement and the Third-party notices carefully to learn how we ensure the safety of your personal information during the process of collection, usage, storage and sharing, and the relevant rights you own. We take industry-leading security technical measures to fully protect your personal information.

To browse and save local files, photos, and media, we will request for access to your device storage when you use such features.

To import apps from your device into the VM, we will request for apps list installed on your device, you should grant us the permissions, otherwise this feature will not be available.

The VM supports virtual hardware, such as cameras, microphones, GPS, sensors, vibrators, etc., which rely on the real hardware on your device. When you use some virtual hardware, we will ask for your consent before using the real hardware, and you can choose to refuse. Although this will cause the virtual hardware fail to work, it will not affect your continued use of Virtual Master.

We’ll collect your OAID and Android ID to do diagnostics when you encounter any technical difficulties and to do statistics of the overall usage of Virtual Master. We’ll ask for your authorization before collecting your OAID and Android ID.

For details about the third-party services used by the product, such as SDK, you can read the Third-party notices.

Please click “I Agree” to consent to our Privacy Statement and start to use this app.
